text.en: Dog owners enthusiastically commend Ingo Loge for his patience, deep understanding of canine psychology, and supportive teaching style. Clients note that he communicates through subtle, calm cues rather than force or raised voices, creating an encouraging environment. Pet parents appreciate that he trains the humans as much as the dogs during home sessions.

Reviewers report remarkable transformations in dog reactivity, excessive barking, and stubborn boundary issues after single Super Sessions. Pet parents emphasize that Ingo equips families with practical, lasting techniques that fit smoothly into daily life. Multiple clients describe immediate relief as anxious or aggressive dogs settle down comfortably.

Clients consistently praise how quickly fearful, defensive, or unsocialised dogs learn to trust Ingo during training visits. Pet parents describe seeing nervous dogs transform from barking defensively to happily accepting treats and affection within thirty minutes. Reviewers value his compassionate, respectful approach that builds confidence without stress.

q.en: What format do training sessions take?

a.en: Ingo provides in-home Super Sessions lasting around two and a half hours, focusing on practical canine psychology and owner coaching.

q.en: Does the training address severe reactivity or fear?

a.en: Yes, clients report significant progress with reactive barking, territorial aggression, and fear-based behavioural issues.

q.en: Are follow-up advice and check-ins included?

a.en: Reviewers mention that Ingo follows up promptly via call and text to check progress and answer ongoing training questions.

q.en: Does the trainer use force-free and calm techniques?

a.en: Yes, pet owners highlight that training relies on calm body language, consistent boundaries, and positive reinforcement.
